In today’s show, we will discuss:
1. Can loud DJ music make you deaf: How does listening to loud DJ music affect the body, including hearing, heart rate & blood pressure? At what volume and for how long can DJ music damage your ears? Can exposure to loud music cause permanent hearing loss? Can loud DJ music also affect mental health? Who is most at risk from loud music & what precautions can help reduce the damage? Guest: Dr. Vinit Banga, Director, Neurology, Fortis Hospital, Faridabad.
